description: List ledger transactions (charges, refunds, top-ups, invoice settlements and their corrections) on the organization's balance. Each row: type, amount in micros, description, timestamp. Filter by `type` (multi-select) and / or date range.

type.description: Filter by transaction kind. Pass several values to OR them (e.g. ['top_up_manual','crypto_top_up','card_top_up','invoice_settlement'] for every way a balance is funded). Note `invoice_payment_adjustment` is signed: a correction to an already-settled invoice can be either a credit or a debit.

name: list_balance_history
title: List Balance History
